title: Agreement filter: keep only the techniques that both the technique head and the rest of the pipeline pick
question: Product owner's request (2026-10-19): accept a technique only when the pipeline's gate accepts it and the fine-tuned head also picks it. Does that intersection raise precision enough to pay for the recall it drops, on technique extraction and downstream on attribution?

change.filter: a post-gate rule in _assign_states_for_group (TECHNIQUE_HEAD_AGREEMENT): every candidate the gate accepted (on probability or on a cue; verifier verdicts are left alone) of an observation the head scored stays accepted only when the head agrees; the others return to review with the reason recorded. Observations the head did not score (logs, failed requests) are untouched
change.levels: technique: the candidate is the head's most probable technique (rank 1 of its joint technique list); family: the candidate's family is the head's most probable family; top3: the candidate's family is among the head's three most probable families
change.no refit: the acceptance models and their thresholds are unchanged; the filter sits after the gate

arms.pipeline_agree_family: the registered arm: the shipped acceptance model with the head's evidence present only for the filter (head on, the shipped model as the gate, as in the parent's proposer arm), family agreement
arms.head_agree_family: the head-aware pair (schema 4) with family agreement (secondary): the head votes twice, once as evidence and once as the filter

baselines: the parent registration's arms off (the shipped pipeline) and head (the schema-4 pair), artifacts reused
headline: CTI-HAL accepted-set micro-F1, pipeline_agree_family minus off, paired case bootstrap (1,000, seed 7): the interval's lower bound above 0, with precision reported beside it; an arm whose F1 falls is reported as a precision/recall trade, not adopted
constraints: public test pooled micro-F1 not below off beyond its paired interval
for the registered arm: CTI-HAL attribution top-1 not below off and no wrong name; Elastic strict top-1 not below off, no wrong name on the attributed posts, open-set names not above off
secondary: precision, recall, parent-aware F1 per arm and per dataset; how many acceptances the filter removes and how many of those were right
mean technique recall and accepted techniques per report in the attribution runs; named correct, coverage, wrong names
head_agree_family against head (paired) on both sets
selection: none: the three agreement levels are fixed here, one run per arm per set, nothing chosen on test
adoption: only the registered arm can be adopted, as an opt-in setting next to the head (the head stays off by default per the parent); otherwise the result is documented
expectation: precision up and recall down on extraction; F1 most likely down for technique agreement, near flat for family agreement, up only if the pipeline's wrong acceptances are concentrated where the head disagrees; attribution top-1 unlikely to move on 55 reports
cost: laptop only; about 1.5 hours including the attribution checks; no API credit
